Section 'A'
Multiple choice questions.
Circle the correct alternative of the following questions.
1. On which principle does a hydraulic machine base on?
i) Pascal's law
ii) Archimedes principle
iii) Law of floatation
iv) Hydraulic principle
Ans:- i) Pascal's law
2. The weight of floating object is equal to weight of displaced water. In which principle, the statement is based on?
i) Pascal's law
ii) Archimedes principle
iii) Law of floatation
iv) Barometer's principle
Ans:- ii) Archimedes principle
3. In which condition, does a substance having greater density than water float on it?
i) It is pressed
ii) It displaces water equal to its weight.
iii) Its weight is decreased.
iv) Its surface area is decreased.
Ans:- ii) It displaces water equal to its weight.
4. On which law/principle is a lactometer based?
i) Pascal's law
ii) Archimedes' principle
iii) Law of Gravitation
iv) Newton's law
Ans:- ii) Archimedes' principle
5. What is the condition for flying a hydrogen balloon upwards in the air?
i) weight of the balloon=weight of air displaced
ii) weight of balloon > weight of air displaced
iii) weight of the balloon = volume of air displaced
iv) weight of balloon < weight of air displaced
Ans:- iv) weight of balloon < weight of air displaced

correct group of the weights on the smaller piston (𝑊1) and the larger piston (𝑊2) to keep the machine balanced? i) 𝑊1=4N, 𝑊2= 2N ii) 𝑊1= 5N , 𝑊2 = 10𝑁 iii) 𝑊1=2N, 𝑊2 =1N iv) 𝑊1=3N, 𝑊2 = 1.5N Ans:- ii) 𝑊1= 5N , 𝑊2 = 10𝑁 7. ii) 𝑊2 < 𝑊1< 𝑊3
iii) 𝑊3 < 𝑊1<𝑊3
iv) 𝑊3 < 𝑊2<𝑊1
8. When a ship enters a river from a sea. It was found to sink more than before. What is the reason for this?
i) The temperature of seawater is more than that of river water
ii) The density of seawater is more than that of river water
iii) The temperature of seawater is less than that of river water
iv) The density of seawater is less than that of over water
Ans:- ii) The density of seawater is more than that of river water
9. Which one of the following statements is correct for a hand pushing a ball into the water as shown in the
given figure?
i) Equal pressure acts on all parts of the ball under the water.
ii) The more the ball is pushed into the water, the lesser the upthrust it experiences.
iii) The pressure on the ball acts only in the upward direction.
iv) The upthrust on the ball increases until it completely sinks into the water.
Ans:- iv) The upthrust on the ball increases until it completely sinks into the water.
10. If the same magnitude of upthrust acts on the two cubical bale made up of different materials on keeping
them in water. Which one of the following quantities are equal for them?
i) Density ii) weight
iii) volume
iv) mass
Ans:- iii) volume
